releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.9.1 - Active Sessions Crash Fix (2-layer) + Crash Logger
releaseNotes:
• 🛡️ ACTIVE SESSIONS CRASH FIXED (2-layer):
   - Layer 1 (source): duplicate router session rows are now de-duplicated by user+MAC+IP before reaching the UI — the real cause of 'Key was already used' crashes.
   - Layer 2 (UI): session list key is now a unique content composite (never just .id) so identical rows can never collide.
• 🛡️ NEW: Global Crash Logger — if an unexpected exit EVER happens again, the app records the full stack trace (Settings > Diagnostics > Last Crash) so we can fix it instantly without guessing.
• 📶 Seamless install over v1.6.3 / v1.8.0 / v1.9.0 (same signature) — no uninstall needed.

If you still see a crash after updating, open Settings > Last Crash and tell me the stack trace — it will be preserved forever.
